items.label: Asked the pain's position — found the favourite chair
Asked what breathing does to it
Asked the fever and the cold last week
Heard the rub, leaning him forward
12-lead ECG within ten minutes — and read its shape
NSAID — treated the fire, not a clot
Never sent a rub to the cath lab
Named it — pericarditis, not a STEMI
Home on tablets — the sac never filled
Ordered nothing this pericardium did not need
